title: Rabbi David Tawil: Understanding the Amida- Birkat Kohanim (Part 4)- "The Verses"

chapters.title: Introduction to Birkat Kohanim
chapters.about: Context of the blessing within the Amidah

claims: "He explores the commentaries of Rashi and Sforno to explain the meaning of these verses" - The teacher does not mention Sforno's commentary on the first verse (Yevarechecha), only Rashi's. He only brings Sforno for the second verse.
"discusses the importance of receiving this blessing daily" - The teacher discusses the importance of the Kohanim performing the blessing daily, not the importance of the congregation receiving it.
summary: Rabbi Tawil examines the three verses of Birkat Kohanim found in Parashat Naso in the book of Bamidbar. He explores the commentaries of Rashi and Sforno to explain the meaning of these verses and discusses the importance of receiving this blessing daily.
questions: Why did the Hakhamim forbid translating Birkat Kohanim in public?
What is the significance of the word 've-yishmerekha' according to Rashi?
How does the Sforno interpret the radiance of Hashem's face?
Why is shalom considered the ultimate blessing?
Does Hashem bless the Kohanim as well?
